text:
jackie: quick question — we're changing the retention for triage snapshots from 30d -> 90d for a specific set of incidents. who owns the RBAC + KMS unwrap flow for granting short-lived analyst access to those snapshots?

maria: I can own the RBAC side. need to confirm which role we want to grant — thinking `roles/siem.snapshotViewer` scoped to `project:security-audit` and dataset tag `siem:triage`.

kevin: KMS unwrap is trickier. our policy currently requires a CMK unwrap via the `kms-proxy` for any export. we should keep unwrap ephemeral and ticketed.

jackie: sounds good. can we make an oncall-friendly handoff pattern? want analysts to request access during incident reviews without engineering intervention at 3am.

security-oncall: propose this flow: request via ticket template -> auto-approve for oncall if incident severity >= P2 and owner signoff -> ephemeral role grant (4h) -> KMS proxy unwrap with audit webhook. low-touch but logged.

maria: agreed. example request template (one-liner fields):
```
- requester: <email>
- incident_id: <INC-1234>
- justification: "triage: memory dump + flow logs"
- dataset: "siem-snapshots/INC-1234"
- duration: 4h
- scrub_required: yes/no
```

kevin: KMS proxy config snippet for reference:
```yaml
proxy: 
  allowed_principals: ["roles/siem.snapshotViewer"]
  unwrap_ttl: 4h
  audit_webhook: https://hooks.redwood.internal/security/kms-unwrap
  require_ticket: true
```

jackie: Nice. what about retention change? need to update policy doc + inform legal. 90d seems fine for triage snapshots but we must limit which snapshots get extended retention.

maria: we'll gate it by tag: `triage:true` and by origin `incident.created_by:security`. I'll add the policy to the handbook and create an automated tagger in the pipeline.

devops: FYI I can add the IAM grant automation. plan: create a short-lived binding via `gcloud` and a revoke cron. sample command: `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding security-audit --member=user:analyst@redwood.com --role=roles/siem.snapshotViewer --condition='expression=request.ticket_id != null, title="temp-snapshot-access"'`

security-oncall: We also need to ensure SIEM exports are scrubbed before any third-party access. add a mandatory scrub stage where PII fields are masked.

kevin: agree. add a pre-export scrub job + automated checksum audit. keep a copy of pre-scrub hashes in KMS-wrapped envelope for integrity checks.

jackie: can we run this in staging first? I'd like a runbook for oncall: steps to approve, commands to revoke, and expected alerts.

maria: will write the runbook and link it. draft link: https://redwood.internal/security/siem-snapshots-handbook (WIP).

sre-bot: [deploy-bot] staging role automation deployed to staging-project at 2025-06-03T02:45:00Z :rocket:

devops: deployed the automation lambda to staging. pointing to `kms-proxy-staging` and `tagger-staging`. test plan: 1) create test incident 2) file request 3) confirm ephemeral grant 4) confirm KMS unwrap logged.

jackie: test scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PT. @security-oncall can you review the acceptance criteria?

security-oncall: will review and add acceptance checks (audit webhook presence, scrubbed field verification, ticket linkage). also confirm legal is looped for 90d retention opt-in.

maria: created PR for policy + runbook, awaiting review: https://git.internal/redwood/security/merge_requests/542

devops: once PR merges I'll wire automation to prod flags behind `feature/triage-90d`. we will keep `triage=true` opt-in until legal signs off.

jackie: thanks all. action items: maria -> PR + runbook, kevin -> scrub+KMS checks, devops -> staging->prod rollout plan, security-oncall -> acceptance criteria + legal loop. :white_check_mark:

kevin: noted. will add an automated smoke test to validate KMS unwrap logs are sent to `sec-audit` stream.

sre-bot: [audit-bot] ticket #SEC-742 created for this change and linked to the PR.

jackie: perfect. follow-ups in the PR thread.
